sm: The host says his producer has had him watch TikTok videos in which people defend polyamory and open relationships, and he reacts to three of them. In the first, a woman says she just minds her own business; he replies that a husband's sexual activity is his wife's business, and asks what makes it a marriage at all. In the second, a wife cheerfully encourages her husband to sleep with a woman he met on an app, saying she is putting karma in the bank for later. The host calls an open marriage an oxymoron and describes it as mutually agreed adultery that is self-serving and a kind of emotional blackmail, when marriage is meant to be a sacrificial union until death. The third video features a bearded man joking about leftovers after his wife was seen with another man. The host says he is either hiding resentment or has simply been emasculated, calls both options pathetic, and stops watching.
